title: Normalize final 7 legacy closed 1104 task records and clear all done/ schema debt
goal: Reconcile git-verified historical provenance (base_commit, implementation_commit, verified_commit, closed) and surviving Core scopes across the final 7 legacy .agents/tasks/done/T-*1104-1.json records (T-VENDORMODELSSUITESB4T1104-1 through T-ZCVERSETUP1104-1) and remove their 7 entries from tests/task_record_schema_debt.json (31 -> 24, leaving zero done/ entries in schema debt).
notes: Phase 1 normalizes T-VENDORMODELSSUITESB4T1104-1, T-XTLOCALBUILD1104-1, T-XTROUTER1104-1, T-ZCKEYRINGEXP1104-1, T-ZCKEYROT1104-1, T-ZCSETBACKUP1104-1, and T-ZCVERSETUP1104-1 in .agents/tasks/done/ and shrinks tests/task_record_schema_debt.json from 31 to 24 entries (0 done/ entries remaining), leaving all 24 open .agents/tasks/T-*.json entries untouched.

reuse.searched: tests/task_records.rs, tests/task_record_schema_debt.json, and .agents/tasks/done/T-*1104-1.json in Susi Core and susi-dev-workflow in Susi Commercial Apps
reuse.why: Normalized the final 7 legacy closed task records directly to the existing susi.task_record/v1 schema enforced by tests/task_records.rs (using susi_paths::hex::encode) without altering test harness code.
